products.name: Falcon (TII)
products.note: UAE-hosted open-source LLM; sovereign AI; Apache 2.0; Middle East data residency

profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute is a non-profit government research lab founded in 2020, described on its Falcon site as the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). Its site presents the Falcon LLM family as generative large language models intended to make advanced AI accessible, with the company framing the work around efficiency, ethical design, and global scalability.

The Falcon family includes Falcon-H1 and Falcon-E as the latest additions, with Falcon-H1 built on a hybrid Transformer and Mamba architecture. The site also lists Falcon Perception, a multimodal model that combines vision and language so systems can read and understand images from natural language prompts, Falcon Arabic for Modern Standard Arabic and dialects, Falcon H1R 7B for reasoning in mathematics, coding, logic, and instruction-following, and Falcon Mamba 7B, which the company calls the first open source released State Space Language Model. Earlier models named on the site include Falcon 2 11B, Falcon 180B with 180 billion parameters trained on 3.5 trillion tokens, Falcon 40B with 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens, and Falcon 10B. The company says Falcon-H1 outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen, and that Falcon 2 11B outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google's Gemma 7B as independently verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard, where Falcon 180B is described as at the top for pre-trained Open Large Language Models.

The site also describes the launch of the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to open-source generative AI models and their ecosystems, and a Call for Proposals from AI71, an AI company launched by ATRC and VentureOne, offering compute access to developers working with Falcon 10B. The Falcon LLM product is tracked as a UAE-hosted open-source model under Apache 2.0, positioned around sovereign AI and Middle East data residency.
